title: Bounded Agents: Delegation Security for Multi-Agent AI Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.15888v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based agents can act on behalf of a user to access cloud services, call tools, or invoke agents. At session start, the agent's permissions are set but remain static, and each request is evaluated independently, without considering prior actions. Within its permissions, an agent may act contrary to the delegated task, combine individually permitted actions into a prohibited outcome, or delegate authority to a sub-agent without limiting it. A prompt injection poses a risk only if the agent has authority to perform such actions; this is therefore a problem of authorization architecture, not just the model. The Agentic Principal Chain (APC) tracks delegated authority from one principal to the next. APC evaluates each request against the accumulated session state using six authorization checks. translated_title: 有界代理：多代理AI系统的委托安全
translated_abstract: 基于LLM的代理可以代表用户访问云服务、调用工具或调用其他代理。在会话开始时，代理的权限被设置但保持静态，每个请求独立评估，不考虑先前的操作。在其权限范围内，代理可能违背委托任务行事，将单独允许的操作组合成禁止的结果，或在不加限制的情况下将权限委托给子代理。提示注入仅在代理有权执行此类操作时构成风险；因此，这是一个授权架构问题，而不仅仅是模型问题。代理主体链（APC）跟踪从一个主体到下一个主体的委托权限。APC使用六项授权检查，根据累积的会话状态评估每个请求。APC传递并限制委托范围和预算。通过组合闭包，APC检查请求与先前操作，以防止权限滥用。
tldr: 本文提出代理主体链（APC）架构，通过六项授权检查和组合闭包机制，动态跟踪和限制多代理系统中的委托权限，以解决静态权限和提示注入带来的安全风险。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Agentic Principal Chain (APC) architecture, which dynamically tracks and restricts delegated authority in multi-agent systems through six authorization checks and composition closure, addressing security risks from static permissions and prompt injection.
